Anton Silaev showed why he’s a top prospect in his NHL debut & made the case to stay in the #Devils lineup
Devils place Johnathan Kovacevic on injured reserve, recall Anton Silaev

The #Devils called up prospect Anton Silaev from the Utica #Comets, who need a shutdown defenseman following the Johnathan Kovacevic injury 

#AHL
With Kovacevic out, the Devils call up prospect Anton Silaev. He’s the defenseman who plays a lot like Kovacevic as a bigger shutdown defenseman.
